request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:KNIGHT

layers.text: Change no shape: its legs and lower belly are coated in dark chocolate #4a2412 with a wavy dripping edge; a dark chocolate helmet cap covers the top of its head between the ears; one chocolate-bar plate with a caramel gold rim sits on each shoulder; its raised fist wears a dark chocolate glove. The face, chest and arms stay amber jelly. Keep the pose, every shape, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
